name: vision-and-tom-paperclip-runtime
description: Paperclip as it runs on the server. Install with pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prod (exact versions from pnpm-lock.yaml). The overrides replace only the vulnerable versions of packages inside Paperclip with their patched releases (see PROGRESS.md, dependency fixes); Paperclip itself stays pinned. The @opentelemetry packages are Paperclip's optional tracing add-ons at the exact versions its package.json asks for (it checks them); they do nothing unless sudo vt-tracing on is run (docs/TRACING.md).
